source_verification.verification: Original encoded/RGB pins checked; saved152 context crops,140 contact-sheet panels,156 core paired panels and48 closure paired panels independently compared byte-for-byte with original native crops/exact90CW before this reviewer viewed those sheets.

review_frames: Right-region descriptions use exact90CW orientation; frozen/bottom descriptions use native orientation. No arbitrary rotation or mirror equivalence.
limits: Full visible-feature candidate relation at this source resolution only; no cipher identity, letter value or alphabet count.
Closed D11 eligibility is not reopened. Core70, excluded102 and unresolved135 are unchanged; no outside lead is promoted.
No blanket detached-mark historical ownership or all-card alias exclusion follows from local route/context inspection.
Repeated per-unit observations in pair records are serialization of actually inspected pair views, not combinatorially inferred edges.
